==Notes==
*Unlike other quests, his quests can only be completed once per [[account]].
*He only offers the quests to [[level]] 20 [[character]]s.
*His quests all display Great Temple of Balthazar as the location of acquisition in the [[Quest Log]], even if the quest was acquired in one of the other port towns.

==Trivia==
*He uses the same skin as the [[Agent of Balthazar]] [[costume]].
*He is referred to as "Zaishen Recruiter" in the [[Feedback:Developer updates/20110602#PvP Quests|June 2011 Developer Update]] instead of Zaishen Guide.
